scenario: checking an important detail about clothing & personal items
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Checking an Important Detail About Clothing and Personal Items
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: clothing & personal items — checking an important detail about clothing & personal items
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to checking an important detail about clothing & personal items; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Ms Sophie if a garment shrinks when washed.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi chị Sophie món đồ này có bị co lại khi giặt không.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Sophie. Does this shrink when washed?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Sophie. Cái này có bị co lại khi giặt không?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Biết vậy tốt quá, cảm ơn chị.
